Gate 0.3: shasum is not executable from the Windows test shell. The test tries 'shasum -a 256' first, falls back to 'certutil -hashfile test-pdfs/golden-master.pdf SHA256' (parses the 64-hex line; this is the path taken on this machine), and finally to a one-shot node:crypto reference. Hash verified identical across sha256(), certutil, and the reference.

Gate 0.4: no live LLM call was executed by the Implementer (no key in environment, $0 spend). Test committed in self-skipping form test.skipIf(!process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY); note it reads the process environment only, not the .env fallback - export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the shell before npm test to run it.

Gate 0.8 restructured: the spec version renders <App /> twice and writes to a non-TTY stdin, which cannot work under Ink 7 in vitest. Replaced with (a) an end-to-end test driving the real Ink input pipeline via a fake TTY stdin (PassThrough with isTTY/setRawMode stubs) - pressing Enter on 'Create New Wiki (init)' navigates App to the init screen and the frame shows 'Create New Wiki' + 'Press Escape to go back'; (b) a unit test of the exported resolveMenuSelection mapping for all 5 menu items; (c) direct renders of each screen asserting content (TestScreen rendered with autoRun=false so it does not spawn npm test recursively).

Ink 7 API adaptations: render() no longer returns lastFrame(), and non-TTY stdout runs Ink in non-interactive mode where the frame is only written on unmount - TUI tests capture the fake stdout stream and assert after unmount() (documented in tests/tui/menu.test.tsx). Also useInput is gated with { isActive: isRawModeSupported === true } in all screens because Ink 7 throws on non-TTY stdin (isTTY is undefined, not false), and MenuScreen renders a static item list instead of ink-select-input when raw mode is unavailable.

src/cli.ts parse guard: program.parse() runs only when the file is executed directly - guarded by !process.env.VITEST plus an argv[1] vs import.meta.url comparison (case-insensitive on Windows) - so Gate 0.5 can import { program } without hanging or rendering the TUI.
